products.short_description: 1 Mukhi Rudraksha. A textured bead for devotional wear or a personal prayer collection.
products.description:
A Rudraksha bead for a personal prayer space, a considered gift or a devotional collection. Its textured surface gives each piece an individual character.

Product details
Design: 1 Mukhi Rudraksha
Listed origin: Nepali

Traditional use
In Hindu devotional practice, Rudraksha is associated with Shiva. Mukhi refers to the faces marked by grooves on the bead; choose a form that feels meaningful to your own practice.

Care guidance
Keep separately in a soft pouch. Avoid perfume, household chemicals and prolonged soaking; gently wipe with a soft cloth after use.

Please note
Natural materials vary in colour, markings and shape. Select an available option above for the current price. Spiritual associations describe tradition and personal belief, not guaranteed health or financial benefits.
